hypothesis.statement: Directly cutting and exporting an AI reconstruction head can destroy identity, include hidden geometry, or silently use the wrong Unreal coordinate convention.
hypothesis.action: Prepare a non-destructive review scene from the P28 source, seal five Go face cameras and object statistics, require named approval of ten scope checks, then export only approved objects as a separate OBJ or FBX with cm, +Z up and +X forward lineage.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Mechanical preparation is automated while semantic head, neck and eye selection remains reviewable and immutable before MetaHuman Identity import.

blenderSmoke.fixture: existing v79 MetaHuman Identity input only

failureHandling: reject missing, duplicate or unknown approved objects
reject incomplete view or scope review
reject working scene checksum drift before export
reject formats other than OBJ or FBX
decision: Use this gate for a future P28-selected reconstruction; do not auto-cut the head or treat the v79 smoke fixture as reconstruction progress.
